content: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 is a web-application verification standard, so authentication, session, access-control, and cryptography categories do not apply to this invocation-local CLI scratchpad. The applicable design principle is input validation at the trusted service layer; validate key/value shape and size before mutating state, and reject boundary failures atomically. Source: https://owasp.org/www-project-application-security-verification-standard/
